body:

Order Processing

• We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order in the event of suspected fraud, incorrect pricing, product unavailability, or other issues. If your order is canceled, we will promptly refund any amounts paid for items not delivered.

title: Data Processing & Protection
body:
Overview

This Data Processing & Protection statement explains how LMH, operating as Home , processes and protects personal data in connection with Home and our coaching, speaking, and online course Services. It supplements our Privacy Policy.

Roles and Responsibilities

We generally act as a “data controller” when we determine the purposes and means of processing personal data (for example, for Website visitors, email subscribers, and clients). In certain limited situations, such as specific client engagements, we may act as a “data processor,” handling personal data on a client’s instructions under a separate Data Processing Agreement, where required by law.

Categories of Data Processed

We may process the following categories of personal data:
• Contact data (name, email address, phone number)
• Account and booking data (for courses, programs, and coaching)
• Payment-related data (billing information, processed via third-party providers)
• Marketing data (email engagement, preferences, unsubscribes)
• Technical data (IP address, device and browser information, cookies)
• Communication data (messages, feedback, testimonials)

Purposes of Processing

We process personal data to:
• Provide and manage our coaching, speaking, and online course Services
• Operate, maintain, and secure our Website and systems
• Communicate with you, including providing support and responding to inquiries
• Send transactional and, where permitted, marketing communications
• Comply with legal, tax, and accounting obligations
• Analyze performance and improve our offerings

Processors and Third-Party Services

We use third-party service providers (processors) to support our operations, which may include:
• Website hosting and infrastructure
• Email marketing and automation platforms
• Payment processors
• Analytics and performance monitoring tools
• Cloud storage and collaboration platforms

These providers process personal data only on our instructions and are expected to implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data.

Security Measures

We take reasonable steps to protect personal data against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Measures may include:
• Secure connections (HTTPS) for data transmission where available
• Access controls and authentication for systems
• Use of reputable third-party providers with security practices
• Regular updates and maintenance of systems

No system can be completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

International Data Transfers

Because we are based in the United States and may use service providers located in multiple countries, personal data may be transferred outside your jurisdiction. When required by law (for example, for data from the EEA or UK), we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this statement and our Privacy Policy or as required by law. For example:
Contact form submissions may be retained for approximately 12–24 months
Email marketing data is retained until you unsubscribe or we remove inactive subscribers
Client and transaction records may be kept for periods required by tax and accounting laws

Data Subject Rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights such as:
• Access to your personal data
• Correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
• Deletion of your personal data, subject to legal obligations
• Restriction or objection to certain processing activities
• Data portability (in certain circumstances)
• Withdrawal of consent, where processing is based on consent

To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com. If we act as a processor for a client, we may need to forward your request to that client (the controller) and follow their instructions.

Contact

For questions about this Data Processing & Protection statement or our data practices, please contact:
• Email: hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com
• Alternate email: lorenmichaelsharris@gmail.com

title: Accessibility Statement
body:
Our Commitment

LMH, operating as Home , is committed to making Home accessible to as many people as reasonably possible, including people with disabilities. We strive to follow recognized best practices, such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Level AA, where feasible.

Measures We Take

To support accessibility, we aim to:
• Use clear headings, descriptive link text, and logical page structure
• Maintain sufficient color contrast between text and background where possible
• Provide alternative text for key images where appropriate
• Support keyboard navigation for important features
• Avoid relying solely on color to convey information
• Test the Website on modern browsers and devices

Ongoing Improvements

Accessibility is an ongoing process. We regularly review our Website and may make improvements over time as we update content, design, and code. We welcome feedback on how we can enhance accessibility.

Known Limitations

Despite our efforts, certain areas of the Website may not yet be fully accessible, such as:
• Third-party plugins or embedded content that we do not control
• Older videos, documents, or media that may lack transcripts or captions

If you encounter any difficulties, please let us know.

Feedback and Contact
If you experience any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us with:
• The URL of the page
• A description of the issue
• Your browser, device, and any assistive technologies used (if applicable)

Contact:

• Email: hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com
• Alternate email: lorenmichaelsharris@gmail.com

We will do our best to respond and, where feasible, to provide an accessible alternative or remedy the issue.

Enforcement
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may also have the right to contact a governmental or regulatory body regarding accessibility or discrimination concerns.

title: Cookie Policy
body:
What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They help the website recognize your device and store information about your preferences and actions. We also use similar technologies such as pixels and local storage (collectively, “cookies”).

How We Use Cookies

We use cookies on Loren Michaels Harris to:
• Enable basic functionality of the Website
• Remember your preferences and settings
• Analyze Website traffic and usage
• Improve our content, features, and Services
• Support our marketing and advertising efforts (where applicable)

Types of Cookies We Use

The types of cookies we may use include:

Strictly necessary cookies: Essential for the Website to function properly (e.g., security, page navigation). Without these cookies, the Website may not work correctly.

Performance/analytics cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with the Website, such as which pages are visited most often and how users move through the site. We use this information to improve the Website.

Functional cookies: Remember choices you make (such as language preferences) to enhance your experience.

Advertising/targeting cookies (if used): May be used by third-party partners or us to deliver relevant advertisements and track the effectiveness of marketing campaigns. Where required by law, we will ask for your consent before using these cookies.

Third-Party Cookies

We may use third-party services that set cookies on our Website, such as:
• Analytics providers (e.g., to help us understand Website usage)
• Advertising networks
• Social media platforms

These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies, which we encourage you to review.

Cookie Consent

Where required by law, we will display a cookie banner or notice when you first visit the Website to obtain your consent for non-essential cookies. You can update your cookie preferences at any time via the options provided in the banner (if available) or by changing your browser settings.

Managing Cookies

Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:
• Block all cookies
• Block cookies from specific sites
• Delete cookies when you close your browser

Please note that disabling or blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Website and your user experience.

Changes to This Cookie Policy
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. The “Last updated” date at the top indicates the latest revision.

Contact

If you have questions or concerns about our use of cookies, please contact:
• Email: hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com
• Alternate email: lorenmichaelsharris@gmail.com

title: Privacy Policy
body:
Who We Are

This Privacy Policy describes how LMH, operating as Home (“Company”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit Home (the “Website”) or use our coaching, speaking, and online course services (the “Services”).

If you have any questions, you can contact us at:
• Email: hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com (preferred)
• Alternate email: lorenmichaelsharris@gmail.com

Suppose you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom (UK), or another region with data protection laws. In that case, we act as a “data controller” for the personal data we collect about you.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

a) Information you provide directly
• Name and contact details (such as email address and phone number)
• Billing details and transaction-related information (processed via third-party providers)
• Information provided when purchasing, registering for, or using our Services
• Messages sent through contact forms, email, or other communication channels
• Testimonials, feedback, or survey responses you choose to provide

b) Information collected automatically
When you use the Website, we may automatically collect:
• IP address
• Browser type and version
• Device type and operating system
• Pages visited, time spent on pages, and referring URLs
• Approximate location based on IP address
• Cookie identifiers and similar tracking technologies

c) Information from third parties
We may receive information from:
• Payment processors
• Email marketing platforms
• Analytics and advertising providers
• Social media platforms if you interact with our content there

How We Use Your Information

We may use your personal information to:
• Provide, operate, and maintain the Website and Services
• Process and complete orders, bookings, and payments
• Respond to your inquiries, messages, and support requests
• Send transactional communications (e.g., confirmations, receipts, service updates)
• Send marketing communications where permitted by law and your preferences
• Personalize and improve user experience and our offerings
• Analyze Website performance and usage to improve our content and Services
• Detect, prevent, and address technical or security issues
• Comply with legal obligations under U.S. and applicable international law

Legal Bases for Processing (EEA/UK Visitors)

Where data protection laws apply (e.g., GDPR), we rely on one or more of the following legal bases:
• Performance of a contract
• Legitimate interests (such as running, improving, and securing our business and Services)
• Consent (e.g., for certain marketing communications and cookie-based tracking)
• Compliance with legal obligations

Marketing Communications

If you opt in to receive our newsletter, updates, or other promotional communications, we may send you emails about our content, offers, and Services. You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the “unsubscribe” link in our emails or by contacting us at hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to operate our Website, remember your preferences, and analyze Website usage. Some cookies may be necessary for the functioning of the Website, while others are used for analytics or marketing. For more details, please see our Cookie Policy.

How We Share Your Information

  1. We do not sell your personal information. We may share personal information with:
    • Service providers and vendors who perform services on our behalf (e.g., hosting, email, analytics, payment processing)
    • Professional advisors such as lawyers and accountants under confidentiality obligations
    • Government authorities or law enforcement where required by applicable law or to protect our rights, property, or safety
    • Successors or acquirers in connection with a merger, sale, or other business reorganization

These third parties are expected to process personal data only as necessary and to protect it with appropriate safeguards.

  1. International Data Transfers
    We are based in the United States and may use service providers operating in other countries. If you are located in the EEA, UK, or another jurisdiction with data transfer restrictions, your data may be transferred outside your region. Where required by law, we implement appropriate safeguards (such as Standard Contractual Clauses) for international transfers.

  2. Data Retention
    We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, including to:
    • Provide the Services
    • Comply with legal, tax, and accounting requirements
    • Resolve disputes and enforce agreements

When personal data is no longer needed, we will delete it or anonymize it.

  1. Your Rights
    Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal data, including to:
    • Request access to personal data we hold about you
    • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
    • Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal obligations
    • Object to or request restriction of certain processing activities
    • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
    • Lodge a complaint with a data protection authority

To make a request, contact us at hello@lorenmichaelsharris.com. We may request additional information to verify your identity.

Children's Privacy

Our Website and Services are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you believe that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so that we can delete it.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. However, no method of transmission or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Third-Party Websites

The Website may contain links to third-party websites or services that we do not control. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of third-party sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.
